firstPlayerRule: Roll one of the six-sided dice to determine who goes first. After each turn, the player to the left goes next.
clarifications: This edition has a two-player (or team) variation that only changes setup and room cards; the starting instruction is unchanged.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the Hasbro US instructions for the 2023 Clue board game (2–6 players, Clue cards, victim Mr. Black) from the Hasbro instructions site page f6420-clue-board-game and extracted the text with pdftotext. PDF page 4 (printed page 5) begins "Let's Play" with the instruction to roll one of the six-sided dice to determine who goes first, and ends the turn sequence with the player to your left going next; printed page 6 describes the two-player variation. The sheet shows © 2023 Hasbro. SHA-256: c66199be2095ee44a7b1b3c43a7c0dd3dde893f8278cedb9fb822281ff7dba2a. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: The rules do not say whether the highest or lowest roll wins, or how to settle ties.
One die face shows a magnifying glass, which counts as 1 for movement; the rules do not say how to read it when rolling for first player.
Older Clue editions use a different rule (Miss Scarlet goes first); check which edition you own.
